URL: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gyv05gk4do

BBC (scraped 19:25 BST, updated 18:49 BST): toll 22 dead, 85 injured incl two children (State Emergencies Service). Klitschko: 'This is the most massive attack on the Ukrainian capital.' 11-hour attack from ~23:00 GMT Wed: 74 missiles + 496 drones; 25 ballistic missiles and 12 drones struck 33 locations. 52,500 sheltered in metro (4,500 children). Nine-storey block destroyed Darnytskyi; ambulance station hit; Ukrainian Red Cross warehouse destroyed — 320,000 relief items worth £1.3m. Zelensky asked Washington for Patriot manufacture licences. Peskov: 'We will continue to increase pressure on the Kyiv regime in order to achieve our set goals.' Sybiha: 'It would be immoral to justify the Russian strikes by saying they were a response to Kyiv's long-range attacks on Russia.' Corroborated: CNN https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/01/world/russian-strikes-kyiv-zelensky-intl-hnk ; NYT https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/07/02/world/ukraine-kyiv-russia-attack
